1.0.1.en: Fixed: power-on behavior, indicator LED, child lock and backlight settings were not being read or applied on Tuya smart plugs and switches. Added: a 'Reset energy meter' button on smart plugs to zero the energy total shown by Homey.

1.0.3.en: "Improved: device availability detection is more reliable — fixed devices being wrongly marked offline, and a misleading 'available' trigger firing after an app restart. Rejected settings writes are now logged to help diagnose issues."
